about: Hi! I’m Mrida, a CS student in my third year at Western University, passionate about cybersecurity, data analysis, backend development, and building tech solutions that make a difference. My university journey has been a mix of everything, hands-on learning, and leadership, from mentoring first-year students as an Off-Campus Soph, to developing AI-powered tools like LLM-based misinformation checkers and interactive web apps such as MoodMates and Recipe Finder. I’ve gained experience in Python, Java, SQL, PowerBI, full-stack development, APIs, and modular system design, all while learning how to manage projects, collaborate with teammates, and translate complex ideas into practical solutions. Outside of university, I love to swim or experiment with new recipes! If any of this interests you feel free to reach out and connect.
